segments.speaker: A
segments.text: Good morning, what brings you in today?

segments.speaker: B
segments.text: I've had a bad cough for about a week.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: Do you have any fever or chest pain?

segments.speaker: B
segments.text: A little fever at night, but no chest pain.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: Are you taking any medication for it?

segments.speaker: B
segments.text: Just some cough syrup from the pharmacy.

segments.speaker: A
segments.text: Okay, let me listen to your lungs first.
